rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a stricter staged curriculum: non-final recurrent tail blocks stay fully off until each block clears most of its own stage window, then ramp to the existing min-gain floor and finally to full strength. This is a compact, compile-stable recurrence-scheduling change aimed at spending early 600s budget on the base path before turning on shallower tail reuse.
title: Hard-Staged Reverse-Tail Recurrence Curriculum
